entities.name: Daniela Pejšová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daniela Pejšová is a Czech professional ice hockey player for the Boston Fleet of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). She previously played for Luleå HF/MSSK and Modo Hockey of the Swedish Women's Hockey League (SDHL). She is also a member of the Czech Republic women's national ice hockey team. She was drafted seventh overall by Boston in the 2024 PWHL draft.
